tools.name: meet.whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Who you are signed in as, and whether you can start meetings here.

tools.name: meet.create
tools.title: Start a meeting
tools.description: Start a meeting now. Returns the join link to share, and a host link that makes whoever opens it the host.

waiting_room.description: Hold guests in a waiting room until a host lets them in (default on)

kind.description: meeting, or webinar: a few speakers and many viewers

linked_record.description: Optional link to a record in another app, for example crm:deal:42 or board:task:7

tools.name: meet.schedule
tools.title: Schedule a meeting
tools.description: Schedule a meeting for later. Returns the join link and a calendar invite (.ics text) to send.

starts_at.description: When it starts, ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-12T15:00:00Z

waiting_room.description: Hold guests until a host lets them in (default on)

linked_record.description: Optional link to another app's record

tools.name: meet.list
tools.title: List meetings
tools.description: List meetings: live ones first, then upcoming, then recent.

tools.name: meet.get
tools.title: Get a meeting
tools.description: Get one meeting by id or join link: title, time, status and settings. Anyone with the link can read this much.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.update
tools.title: Change a meeting
tools.description: Change a meeting: title, time, length, waiting room, webinar mode, or how media is carried.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

media_pref.description: auto picks for you; the others force one way

tools.name: meet.cancel
tools.title: Cancel a meeting
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled meeting and delete it with its chat.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.invite
tools.title: Make an invite
tools.description: Make an invitation: the join link, a short message to paste, and a calendar invite. It does not send email; the Email app or you send it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

names.description: Who it is for, to address the message

tools.name: meet.join
tools.title: Join a meeting
tools.description: Join a meeting by its link. Guests give a name and need no account. With a waiting room on, guests wait until a host admits them; call again with the same ticket to check.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

name.description: Your name as others will see it (guests)

host_key.description: The host key from a host link, which makes you the host

as.description: agent: an AI agent joining by itself (shown with an agent badge)

tools.name: meet.leave
tools.title: Leave
tools.description: Leave the meeting. Others stay in the call.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.end
tools.title: End for everyone
tools.description: End the meeting for everyone.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.list_waiting
tools.title: List the waiting room
tools.description: Who is in the waiting room, oldest first.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.admit
tools.title: Let someone in
tools.description: Let someone in from the waiting room. Use all: true to let everyone in.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.deny
tools.title: Turn someone away
tools.description: Turn someone away from the waiting room.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.list_participants
tools.title: List people
tools.description: Everyone admitted to the meeting, whether they are in the call now, and their mic, camera, screen and hand.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.room_status
tools.title: Call status
tools.description: How the call is carried right now (direct, by computers in the call, or by a media server), the people limit, the computers helping, and your own status.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.set_my_media
tools.title: Turn my mic or camera on or off
tools.description: Turn your own microphone or camera on or off. The first time, the browser asks the person to allow the camera and microphone; only they can click that. Granting camera and microphone permission is a browser prompt only the person can answer (ROADMAP 3.3).

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.set_background
tools.title: Blur my background
tools.description: Blur the background behind you on your own camera, or stop. Done on your device (MediaPipe selfie segmentation); nobody else's camera can be changed.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.mute_participant
tools.title: Mute someone
tools.description: Host: mute someone's microphone, or turn off their camera. Nobody can turn another person's mic or camera on; you can only ask.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

video.description: Turn their camera off as well

tools.name: meet.remove_participant
tools.title: Remove someone
tools.description: Host: remove someone from the meeting. They cannot rejoin with the same ticket.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.set_role
tools.title: Change someone's role
tools.description: Host: make someone a co-host, a member again, or in a webinar a speaker or a viewer.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.lock
tools.title: Lock the meeting
tools.description: Host: lock the meeting so nobody new can join, or unlock it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.set_waiting_room
tools.title: Turn the waiting room on or off
tools.description: Host: turn the waiting room on or off. Turning it off lets everyone waiting in.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.request_screen_share
tools.title: Ask to share a screen
tools.description: Ask someone (or yourself) to share their screen. Their screen shows a button; the person picks the screen or window in the browser's picker. Only a person can pick. Choosing which screen or window to share is the browser's picker, which only the person can use (ROADMAP 3.3).

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

participant.description: Who to ask; leave out for yourself

tools.name: meet.set_sharing
tools.title: Start or stop sharing
tools.description: Record that you started or stopped sharing your screen. Stopping also asks your screen to stop the share.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

participant.description: Host only: stop someone else's share

tools.name: meet.set_layout
tools.title: Grid or speaker view
tools.description: Choose how you see the call: grid (everyone the same size) or speaker (whoever talks is large).

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.raise_hand
tools.title: Raise or lower my hand
tools.description: Raise or lower your hand. In a webinar, a raised hand asks the host to let you speak.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.send_chat
tools.title: Send a chat message
tools.description: Send a message to everyone in the meeting chat.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.list_chat
tools.title: Read the chat
tools.description: Read the meeting chat, oldest first. Pass after to get only newer messages.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.huddle
tools.title: Open a huddle
tools.description: The room API for other apps: open (or find) the live room for a record such as a Chat channel, with no waiting room, and join it. Chat huddles use this.

for.description: The record the room belongs to, for example chat:channel:general

tools.name: meet.add_host
tools.title: Help carry this call
tools.description: Offer your computer to help carry this call. Returns the command to run (Node 22 or newer), or the desktop app does it for you. The computer forwards media it cannot see: it is end-to-end encrypted.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.list_hosts
tools.title: List computers carrying the call
tools.description: The computers offered to carry this call, whether each is carrying it, its measured upload, and how many people it can take.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.export
tools.title: Export everything
tools.description: Export everything you host: meetings, who joined, chat, transcripts, notes and consent records, as JSON.

tools.name: meet.doctor
tools.title: Check calls can connect
tools.description: Check this server for calls: public address, UDP out, TURN, TLS, and the media server if one is set. Says in plain words what is wrong.

tools.name: meet.start_notes
tools.title: Turn notes on
tools.description: Turn on AI notes. Everyone in the call sees and hears a notice, and each person's own device writes down only what that person says, once they agree. Words are kept with the meeting while notes are on. Host or co-host only.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

send_to.description: Where the notes go when the meeting ends (each is optional)

crm.description: A CRM record: crm:deal:<id or name>, crm:contact:..., crm:org:...; or "linked" for the meeting's own record

board.description: The board client to add action items to

chat.description: A Chat channel to post the notes in

email.description: Email the notes to everyone in the meeting who is on the team

tools.name: meet.stop_notes
tools.title: Turn notes off
tools.description: Turn AI notes off. Nothing more is written down; what was written stays with the meeting until the host deletes it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.answer_notes
tools.title: Answer the notes notice
tools.description: Your answer to the notes notice: include your voice in the notes, or leave it out. Change it any time. Also says how your device writes down your words (engine), so the call can find a helper when it cannot.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

include.description: true: your words go in the notes. false: your microphone is never written down.

engine.description: How your device transcribes: whisper-webgpu, whisper-wasm (both on this device), web-speech (the browser's speech service), none (cannot)

shown_at.description: When you saw the notice, ISO 8601 (defaults to now)

tools.name: meet.notes_status
tools.title: Notes status
tools.description: Whether notes are on, who turned them on, each person's answer and how their words are written down (their own device, a helper in the call, or the server), and which model writes the notes.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.add_transcript
tools.title: Add to the transcript
tools.description: Add lines to the transcript: what you said, written down by your own device (or, as a helper, what someone you write for said). Only while notes are on and only for people who agreed.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

id.description: Your id for this line, so sending it twice keeps one

start_at.description: When they started speaking, ISO 8601 or milliseconds

tools.name: meet.transcribe_audio
tools.title: Transcribe a clip on the server
tools.description: For a device that cannot transcribe: send a short clip of your own speech (WAV, under 30 s) and the team's speech service writes it down. Only when the team set one up, and only while notes are on and you agreed.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

start_at.description: When the clip starts, ISO 8601 or milliseconds

tools.name: meet.get_transcript
tools.title: Get the transcript
tools.description: Read a meeting's transcript: who said what and when, in order. Pass after (a time) to get only newer lines.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

after.description: Only lines that start after this time, ISO 8601 or milliseconds

tools.name: meet.summarise
tools.title: Write meeting notes
tools.description: Write the meeting notes from the transcript: a summary, decisions and action items. Uses the team's model when one is set (Settings, Notes); otherwise a labelled script writes demo notes. Runs by itself when the meeting ends.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.get_notes
tools.title: Read meeting notes
tools.description: Read the meeting notes (summary, decisions, action items), which model wrote them, and where they were sent.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.notes_to_crm
tools.title: Save notes to the CRM
tools.description: Save the notes as a meeting activity on a CRM record (the meeting's linked deal, contact or organization, or the one you name). Writes the notes first if needed. Inside wOS.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

record.description: crm:deal:<id or name>, crm:contact:..., or crm:org:... (defaults to the meeting's linked record)

tools.name: meet.notes_to_board
tools.title: Add action items to the board
tools.description: Add each action item from the notes as a task on the board, for a client, with its owner and due day when the notes name them. Inside wOS.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

client.description: The board client the tasks are for (defaults to the one chosen when notes were turned on)

assign.description: Assign each task to the person the notes name (default on); off leaves them unassigned

tools.name: meet.notes_to_chat
tools.title: Post notes in Chat
tools.description: Post the notes in a Chat channel: the channel the meeting started from, or the one you name. Inside wOS.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

channel.description: Channel name or id (defaults to the channel the call started in)

tools.name: meet.notes_to_email
tools.title: Email the notes
tools.description: Email the notes to the people in the meeting who are on the team (or the members you name), through the Email app. Guests are not emailed. Inside wOS.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

to.description: Team members (email or id); defaults to every team member who joined

tools.name: meet.delete_transcript
tools.title: Delete the transcript and notes
tools.description: Delete a meeting's transcript and notes. Host only. The consent records stay, as proof of what people agreed to.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.get_settings
tools.title: Read Meetings settings
tools.description: The notes model, speech service and recording storage this team (or, standalone, you) set up. Keys are never shown, only whether they are set.

tools.name: meet.set_settings
tools.title: Change Meetings settings
tools.description: Set the model that writes notes (any OpenAI-compatible address, model and key), a speech service for devices that cannot transcribe, and S3-compatible storage for recordings. Empty clears a value. Keys are stored encrypted.

notes_model_url.description: OpenAI-compatible address for meeting notes, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1

notes_model.description: Model name, for example gpt-4.1-mini or llama3.1

notes_model_key.description: API key for that address (leave empty for a local server)

transcribe_url.description: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text address (Whisper), used only for people whose device cannot transcribe

transcribe_model.description: Speech model name, for example whisper-1

transcribe_key.description: API key for the speech service

tools.name: meet.start_recording
tools.title: Start recording
tools.description: Ask everyone in the call to agree to recording. Every screen shows a notice that has to be answered; recording starts once everyone answered (or after 45 s), and anyone who said no or did not answer is left out of the picture and the sound. Host or co-host only. Each answer is stored (ROADMAP F11).

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.answer_recording
tools.title: Answer the recording notice
tools.description: Your answer to the recording notice: agree to be recorded, or not. If you say no, you are left out of the picture and the sound. You can change your answer while it records.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

agree.description: true: you are in the recording. false: you are left out.

shown_at.description: When you saw the notice, ISO 8601 (defaults to now)

tools.name: meet.recording_status
tools.title: Recording status
tools.description: Whether the call is being recorded: asking, recording or stopped; who agreed, who said no, who is being asked; which browser records; and where the file was saved.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

recording.description: Recording id (defaults to the meeting's latest)

tools.name: meet.stop_recording
tools.title: Stop recording
tools.description: Stop the recording. The browser that recorded it then saves the file to its disk or to the team's storage.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.recording_upload_url
tools.title: Get an upload link for a recording
tools.description: A one-hour link to upload the recording straight to the team's S3-compatible storage (set in Settings). For the browser that recorded it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

recording.description: Recording id (defaults to the meeting's latest)

tools.name: meet.save_recording
tools.title: Save a recording
tools.description: Record where the finished recording went (your disk, or the team's storage), its size and length, so the meeting lists it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

recording.description: Recording id (defaults to the meeting's latest)

tools.name: meet.list_recordings
tools.title: List recordings
tools.description: The meeting's recordings: when, who asked, where each was saved, size and length. Recordings saved to someone's disk are listed but only they have the file.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.get_recording
tools.title: Get a recording
tools.description: One recording, with a one-hour download link when it is in the team's storage, and who agreed to be in it.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

recording.description: Recording id (defaults to the meeting's latest)

tools.name: meet.delete_recording
tools.title: Delete a recording
tools.description: Delete a recording: the file in the team's storage and the record of it. Host only. A copy saved to someone's disk is theirs to delete. Consent answers are kept as proof.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

recording.description: Recording id (defaults to the meeting's latest)

tools.name: meet.open_whiteboard
tools.title: Open the whiteboard
tools.description: Open the meeting's whiteboard for everyone in the call (it is made the first time). Everyone draws on the same board; strokes go between browsers encrypted with the meeting key.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.close_whiteboard
tools.title: Close the whiteboard
tools.description: Put the whiteboard away for everyone in the call. It stays saved with the meeting. The person who opened it or a host.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.get_whiteboard
tools.title: Get the whiteboard
tools.description: The meeting's whiteboard: whether it is open, its text, how many shapes, where it was attached; with full: true, also the drawing (Excalidraw elements) and its merge state.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

full.description: Also return the drawing and its state

tools.name: meet.save_whiteboard
tools.title: Save the whiteboard
tools.description: Save the whiteboard to the meeting: its merge state, the drawing as Excalidraw elements, and pictures (SVG, and PNG when small). Browsers in the call do this by themselves a few seconds after each change; an agent can draw by sending elements.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.export_whiteboard
tools.title: Export the whiteboard
tools.description: The whiteboard as a picture: SVG (text) or PNG (base64), as last saved.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

tools.name: meet.attach_whiteboard
tools.title: Attach the whiteboard
tools.description: Attach the whiteboard to a CRM record (as a note with its text and a link) or a board task (as a comment). Inside wOS.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

to.description: crm:deal:<id or name>, crm:contact:..., crm:org:..., or board:task:<id>

tools.name: meet.join_as_agent
tools.title: Join as an agent
tools.description: Send an AI agent into the call as a participant that listens and, if the host allows, speaks. It waits in the waiting room with an Agent badge until a host lets it in, and everyone sees it while it is there. Designed, not built yet: see docs/AGENT-PARTICIPANT.md. Planned for v1.

meeting.description: Meeting id, or the token from its join link

purpose.description: One line shown to everyone: why it is here

listen.description: Transcribe the people who agreed to notes (default on)

speak.description: Allowed to speak when asked (default off)
